scenarios.title: update_book
scenarios.when: PUT /books/1 with JSON {"title": "Nineteen Eighty-Four", "author": "George Orwell", "isbn": "123456", "synopsis": "A dystopian novel"}

scenarios.title: duplicate_id_in_create
scenarios.when: POST /books with same fields as book 1

logic: store books in dict keyed by id, assign sequential ids, validate required fields non-empty, reject empty/missing fields; on POST create new id, reject duplicate id; on GET/PUT/DELETE retrieve/modify/delete; return appropriate HTTP status and JSON
